body.text: Every practical antalya cruise port guide starts with one logistical fact: [QTerminals Antalya (Port Akdeniz)](https://www.qterminals-antalya.com/cruise/) is a major multipurpose harbor with separate quays for cruise vessels, containers, and bulk cargo ([TÜRKLİM](https://www.turklim.org/en/turklim-members/qterminals-antalya/)). Unlike Kuşadası or Bodrum, you cannot step off the gangway directly into a historic quarter. You need clear timing across Antalya's western coastal corridor and eastern Pamphylian plains. At [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/), our two founders build shore days under a flat-fee, client-paid model ("Paid by our clients. Independent of provider commissions."), ensuring your hours go toward Roman amphitheaters and courtyard kitchens rather than jewelry factories.
How far is Port Akdeniz from Kaleiçi Old Town (25 min) and Perge (45 min)?

Port Akdeniz sits roughly 14 kilometers west of Kaleiçi Old Town—a 25-minute private drive along Konyaaltı Beach Boulevard—and 32 kilometers southwest of ancient Perge, which takes 45 minutes via the D400 northern ring road. Lower Düden Falls, where the river plunges 40 meters off the Lara cliffs into the Mediterranean, lies 35 minutes east of the pier.

Timing matters on Antalya's east–west arteries. Morning commuter traffic peaks between 08:00 and 09:15 along Konyaaltı Boulevard, so departing right after ship clearance and heading east to Perge first via the outer ring road avoids downtown bottlenecks completely. Official admission details for Pamphylian archaeological sites are published on the [Ministry of Culture and Tourism E-Ticket portal](https://muze.gov.tr/ETicket).
Can you combine Aspendos and Kaleiçi in one cruise call?

Yes—provided your ship stays in port at least 7.5 to 8 hours and you use a private vehicle rather than a multi-stop ship bus. Aspendos's intact 2nd-century AD Roman theater lies 55 kilometers east of Port Akdeniz (60 to 65 minutes each way), leaving enough room to pair it with Perge or Lower Düden Falls plus a two-hour afternoon walk in Kaleiçi.

body.text: Here is a realistic eight-hour private pacing checklist for combining Aspendos, Perge, and Kaleiçi:

items: 08:15: Meet your driver and licensed guide directly outside the QTerminals cruise passenger hall.
09:20: Arrive at Aspendos Theater before group coaches crowd the stone seating tiers and acoustics stage.
10:35: Drive 25 minutes west to Perge to walk the Hellenistic towers, Roman baths, and central water channel.
12:30: Head into Kaleiçi for a shaded courtyard lunch near Hadrian's Gate and a slow stroll down to the old Roman harbor.
14:45: Depart Kaleiçi for Port Akdeniz, reaching the cruise gate by 15:15—a full hour before a 16:15 all-aboard.

body.text: Why is pre-booked private transport essential from the industrial port gate?

QTerminals Antalya sits inside a secure industrial zone surrounded by highway interchanges, cargo staging yards, and heavy freight trucks. Public city buses do not enter the cruise berth, walking out to the main road is unsafe and exposed to sun, and port-gate taxis rarely offer fixed-price multi-hour archaeological loops with English-speaking drivers.

A pre-registered private vehicle with TURSAB-licensed operator credentials enters the designated cruise pickup bay inside the port perimeter. You step from air-conditioned customs clearance directly into your waiting minivan, keep spare sun hats or purchases safely locked in the cabin, and eliminate haggling over return fares from rural sites like Perge or Aspendos where vacant taxis do not wait.
Where are the best shaded lunch spots in Kaleiçi?

Skip the sun-baked rooftop terraces right above the yacht harbor that target cruise passengers with inflated fish platters. Instead, walk five minutes uphill from the harbor into the quiet stone lanes around Hesapçı Sokak and Hıdırlık Tower, where restored Ottoman mansions hide walled citrus gardens cooled by bitter-orange trees and stone fountains.

Order regional Antalya specialties that hold up well in warm weather: piyaz made with tiny local white beans and creamy sesame tahini sauce, charcoal-grilled şiş köfte, wood-fired pide, and burnt goat's-milk ice cream (yanık dondurma). Because Kaleiçi's narrow lanes are restricted to pedestrian traffic, your driver drops you at Hadrian's Gate or Clock Tower and collects you at the lower harbor lift—saving an uphill climb in afternoon heat.

faq.q: Is there a shuttle bus from Port Akdeniz to Antalya city center?
faq.a: Some cruise lines sell paid transfer shuttles to Konyaaltı or the edge of Kaleiçi, but QTerminals Antalya does not run a permanent free municipal shuttle. Pre-booked private transport provides faster door-to-door timing.

faq.q: Which Düden waterfall is better for a cruise stop—Upper or Lower Düden?
faq.a: Lower Düden Falls is far easier to fit into a cruise call because it sits on the coastal cliffs between Kaleiçi and Lara Beach, requiring just a 20-minute park stop with dramatic sea views. Upper Düden sits inland in a forested park that adds extra city driving.

faq.q: How hot does Perge get during summer cruise calls?
faq.a: From June through September, inland Pamphylian plains around Perge and Aspendos frequently exceed 35°C by midday with almost no shade. Schedule Perge and Aspendos first thing in the morning and save shaded Kaleiçi for afternoon.

faq.q: Is the Antalya Archaeology Museum worth adding on a shorter port day?
faq.a: Yes. Located near the eastern end of Konyaaltı Beach—roughly 20 minutes from Port Akdeniz—the museum displays remarkably intact Roman marble statues excavated directly from Perge inside air-conditioned galleries.

faq.q: Can cruise guests visit Kaleiçi if they have limited mobility?
faq.a: Yes, with smart routing. Have your driver drop you near the Kaleiçi panoramic elevator (next to Republic Square) rather than walking steep cobbled slopes, and choose level courtyard restaurants near Hadrian's Gate.

faq.q: How early should we return to Port Akdeniz before sailing?
faq.a: Aim to arrive back at the QTerminals Antalya gate at least 60 minutes before your ship's all-aboard call. Afternoon return traffic westbound along Konyaaltı Beach Boulevard can slow down between 16:00 and 18:00.
